requirements.scope: User-amended Codex/Hermes x two tasks x two repetitions, plus one Codex off/on pair. Claude excluded; no account-management API prerequisite; approximate costs accepted.

M2.browser_probe_history: Initial ephemeral-profile navigation timed out. Adding --password-store=basic to the credential-free test profile allowed the unchanged UI tests to pass. Earlier failed probes are not counted as passes.

fresh_trial_replay.scope: Two resumes from an existing fresh paid Harbor trial; no benchmark re-execution.

limits: Single-call local fixture does not resolve ambiguous multi-call native anchors in historical trials.
A bounded temporal match is not an exact provider-native request identifier.
This validates the final recorder with the installed native CLI, not another paid Harbor trial.
HTTP calls retain original body chunks rather than aggregate request_body/response_body snapshots; a null snapshot does not mean empty captured content.
HTTP API blob reachability is sampled at each direction's first and last nonempty chunk; full local raw integrity was checked separately.
WebSocket unknown outcomes without a final response snapshot remain unknown.
inventory.scope: Existing encrypted artifacts and live local platform; no model launches or qualification upgrades.

remaining_release_gates: Complete and validate the exact frozen recorder/worker five-hour run including all interruptions, drain, integrity and artifact identities.
Publish the final qualified/failed result and synchronize release-facing documentation; the running status is not a success claim.
limits: All 66 historical cross-source ambiguities remain explicit; enumerating them does not prove native-session linkage.
HTTP snapshots and raw body chunks are different representations; raw HTTP chunks remain available even where aggregate snapshot columns are null.
Historical real trials retain the recorder actually used; the final candidate changes an offline HTTP/1 observed-end field, not those past recording identities.
Synthetic native CLI and connected soak checks do not increase the count of paid real-provider matrix cases.
No credentials, raw prompts/responses, pcap, TLS secrets or private budget values are included.
